ranked.headline: Multi-omics fusion predicts BRAF inhibitor response in cancer cell lines
ranked.summary: Single-cell foundation models and LLMs are now benchmarked at scale across 495,000 cells for drug response prediction.

ranked.headline: Simulation-derived conformational ensembles are being coupled to measured observables
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and enhanced-sampling simulations now yield ensembles tested against scattering, smFRET, torque, and in vivo data.

ranked.headline: Residue-level energetics and side-chain flexibility resolve binding determinants
ranked.summary: Attributing recognition energetics to individual residues and side chains now extends from docking to allosteric interfaces.

ranked.headline: Augmentation and embedding strategies for limited-label sequence classification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair generative augmentation and genomic language models with limited labeled biological sequence data.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link genome architecture to size and evolutionary history
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies now allow direct tests of how architecture, transposons and population size shape genome evolution across lineages.

ranked.headline: Biologically constrained embeddings for single-cell and spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple learned representations of single-cell and spatial omics to explicit biological structure, rather than generic reconstruction.

ranked.headline: In silico screen identifies TAD boundary regulators; ZNF654 validated as CTCF partner
ranked.summary: Recent preprints chart human centromere and telomere variation and regulatory genome architecture using long-read sequencing and AI-based screening.

ranked.headline: Association methods move past marginal tests toward epistasis and causal architecture
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale datasets now allow direct testing of epistasis, co-expression and regulatory causal graphs against complex traits.

ranked.headline: Foundation models couple histopathology images with text, genomic and spatial readouts
ranked.summary: Two published pathology foundation models add multimodal knowledge and fairness-aware adaptation, and preprints extend the approach to spatial omics.

ranked.headline: Learned models cut annotation dependence across cell microscopy tasks
ranked.summary: Learned models are reducing manual annotation demands across cell segmentation, profiling, and cell cycle inference in microscopy.

ranked.headline: Single-cell transcriptomes attribute genetic and signaling effects to specific cell types
ranked.summary: Recent methods pair single-cell atlases and healthy-tissue references with genetic and bulk cohorts to map disease effects onto cell types.

ranked.headline: Contrastive and optimal-transport methods for molecule-protein interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work combines graph, sequence, and alignment-based learning to address scarce labels in molecule-protein and enzyme-reaction tasks.

ranked.headline: Known-truth simulators and benchmarks are tuning sequencing analysis tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair simulators and benchmarks with controlled evaluation across long-read, nanopore, metagenomic, and CRISPR workflows.

ranked.headline: New estimators recover spatial and single-cell structure from noisy expression data
ranked.summary: Five preprints and publications from December 2025 address denoising, batch correction, and spatial inference for high-dimensional expression data.

ranked.headline: Compact sequence indexes repurposed for pangenome, ancient DNA and long-read analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers recombine k-mer, minimizer, sketch and graph-path primitives for targeted pangenome and sequencing analyses.

ranked.headline: Conditioning generative models on constraints to steer protein and molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply conditioning, synthesis constraints, and RL to steer generative protein and molecule design toward target properties.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking analysis pipeline choices across omics, microbiome and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Analysis choices in omics pipelines are increasingly tested against known differences or benchmark criteria rather than assumed.

ranked.headline: Software tools for haplotype blocks, crossover estimation, and genotyping simulation
ranked.summary: Phased genotype and recombination structure now underpins new software for minor-allele haploblock detection, crossover mapping, and GBS simulation.

ranked.headline: Latent representations of neural activity across scales, modalities and recording types
ranked.summary: Six December 2025 preprints pair self-supervised and dynamical latent models with heterogeneous spike, LFP, iEEG, EEG and fMRI data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links sequences and spectra to modification sites and molecular identity
ranked.summary: Pretrained language model embeddings are now paired with feature fusion and stacked decision layers across sequence and spectral prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Simulation and parametrization choices shape GPCR, residence-time and torsion predictions
ranked.summary: Late-2025 papers make collective-variable, residence-time and parametrization choices explicit as reportable method elements.

ranked.headline: Graph-based and 3D structural methods mine conserved interaction and sequence patterns
ranked.summary: Recent tools convert macromolecular structure and sequence data into computable representations for pattern mining.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic and multi-omics models stratify drug and checkpoint-blockade responders
ranked.summary: Single-cell and bulk RNA-seq profiles are increasingly used to define responder subgroups and individualized predictive panels.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models link bacterial gene content and metabolism across strains and species
ranked.summary: Genome-scale metabolic models are now applied at population scale, from 7,835 Klebsiella genomes to codon-based gene association across 15,005 bacteria.

ranked.headline: Cell-type and spatially conditioned correction of technical variation in omics data
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell and spatial methods condition batch correction, QC and variable-gene detection on cell type or neighbourhood rather than globally.

ranked.headline: Computational resolution of atom provenance and stereochemical metabolite identity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize isotopomer enumeration and stereochemistry-aware metabolite assignment, alongside a curated terpene synthase reaction resource.

ranked.headline: Format-aware compiled kernels and k-mer pre-filtering speed genomic annotation workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target annotation validation, long-read isoform discovery and interval arithmetic with compiled or pre-filtering implementations.

ranked.headline: Platform-aware calibration and imputation across array and sequencing genomic data
ranked.summary: Mega-analyses and biobank-scale panels across EPICv2 and MSA arrays make platform-specific bias a direct concern for genomic inference.

ranked.headline: Structure-based energy models for ligand binding, RNA folding, and protein stability
ranked.summary: Automated and differentiable energy frameworks now extend to membrane proteins, RNA, and protein conformational landscapes.

ranked.headline: Standardized feature scoring of gene sets, isoforms, and regulatory elements
ranked.summary: Recent R toolkits and genome-wide regulatory modules standardize scoring of gene sets, isoform switches, and single-cell chromatin features.

ranked.headline: RNA-binding proteins couple exon inclusion to chromatin and NMD-linked decay
ranked.summary: Exon-flank RBP binding is now linked to histone marks, while tumor NMD efficiency and glioma splicing are mapped at scale.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative design extends to nucleases and antibody repertoires
ranked.summary: Structure-conditioned design now targets nuclease scaffolds and antibody repertoires with explicit developability and binding objectives.

ranked.headline: Post-calling evidence and upstream consensus calling refine variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Long-read and germline workflows now pair population frequencies and automated ACMG rules, while consensus calling limits caller-specific artifacts.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors lose reliability on disordered, amyloid, and designed targets
ranked.summary: Preprints now benchmark AlphaFold3 and peer predictors on disordered, amyloid, and nanobody-ligand targets beyond ordered domains.

ranked.headline: Neural models fit mechanistic dynamics from time-series omics and reaction networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair neural approximation with explicit mechanistic form to fit trajectory, multiomics, and reaction-network data.

ranked.headline: Computational protein localization and secretory pathway inference from proteomic data
ranked.summary: Open-source tools and curated pathway reconstructions now link spatial proteomics and omics data to protein localization and antibody production mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics resolves microbial ecotypes, phototrophy, and taxonomic boundaries
ranked.summary: Reproducible amplicon workflows and genome-scale phylogenomics now resolve environmental microbial lineages at finer taxonomic and ecotype resolution.

ranked.headline: Quantitative genomic criteria defining bacterial taxa and horizontal gene transfer
ranked.summary: Sequence-derived quantitative frameworks for bacterial taxonomy and HGT detection are advancing, with new hierarchical encodings of taxonomic boundaries.

ranked.headline: Perturbation response models are judged by generalizability and transportability
ranked.summary: Recent work tests perturbation models against single-cell, drug response, gene network, and in vivo human ground truth.

ranked.headline: Tools rank tumor neoantigens using sequencing, expression and HLA-linked evidence
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a glioma study extend neoantigen prioritization to trial workflows, checkpoint response and off-target risk.
